summary: Pony AI Inc. filed a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent disclosure for a foreign private issuer) accompanied by a Hong Kong Exchange announcement giving notice of a board meeting to be held November 18, 2026. The board will consider and approve the group's unaudited third-quarter 2026 results and their publication, with a management earnings call the same day and a replay available through November 25, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, or recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine results-calendar notice; no special-situation event is present.
